desc:
"The Last Thing D Needs" -- The second keynote of DConf 2014, by Scott Meyers. From the abstract:

======================================================
Based on his 25 years of experience with C++, Scott Meyers will offer a recommendation—almost a plea—regarding the D programming language and its community.
======================================================
More info: https://dconf.org/2014/

recs.x: Yes, and everyone should watch Scott Meyers's awesome presentation at a D conference with the title "The Last Thing D Needs". (tl,dr version: The last thing D needs is someone like him, really to be so insanely convoluted, as C++ is, as to need someone like him.) Link to the video: [link]

> You cannot say the same thing about Rust.

At least not yet. My fear is it's _very_ easy to fall in to the same trap as C++ has, and become a big mess. Scott Meyers have a very nice talk here: [link] about all these traps and pifalls that we have to deal with in C++.

recs.stt: Never trust a programmer who says they know C++
